title: PROD-022 PROD-021 review gap packet
purpose: Convert the failed PROD-021 gate into exact gap turns and narrow fix targets before runtime promotion.

gap_categories.description: Runtime policy actions collapse specific sales states into generic clarification or autonomy moves.
Sale-ready language without payment collection is not converted into the sale-ready call-control outcome.
Procurement and stakeholder review language is treated as an ending signal instead of a continuation signal.

fix_targets.implementation_note: Map price, comparison, autonomy, stakeholder, trust, and callback signals to explicit policy actions before composer hooks choose wording.
Recognize verbal commitment or sale-ready next-step agreement while keeping payment collection out of scope.
Keep written-info, boss-review, procurement, and future-review turns in continue-call unless the customer explicitly ends the conversation.
Hook wording gains survived, but hooks are not the owner of policy action or call-control correctness.

prioritized_next_actions.action: Fix policy-action routing for the ten gap turns before changing retrieval or voice behavior.
prioritized_next_actions.rationale: The failed gate is mostly policy/action routing, not hooks; hook wording gain cannot substitute for correct dialogue state.

prioritized_next_actions.action: Stop treating written-info or delayed-approval language as an end-call signal.
prioritized_next_actions.rationale: Two call-control misses came from procurement review language that should remain a low-pressure continuation.

prioritized_next_actions.action: Add sale-ready recognition for verbal next-step agreement without payment collection.
prioritized_next_actions.rationale: One call-control miss blocked the MVP safe-close metric even though the customer was ready for a next step.

prioritized_next_actions.action: Keep PROD-020 hooks available only behind the explicit opt-in flag.
prioritized_next_actions.rationale: The hooks improved four turns and caused no safety regression, but runtime promotion remains blocked.
